annotations.title: Adopt, decline, mark not relevant, or remove items

description: Records an action on catalog items: adopt marks an item as in use; decline marks it as rejected; not_relevant marks it as a poor fit for the agent's job, not a quality judgment; remove marks a previously adopted item as uninstalled. The coach measures only adopted items. Requires the agent's api_key.

action.description: adopt: mark as in use; remove: mark a previously adopted item as uninstalled; decline: mark as rejected; not_relevant: mark as a poor fit for the agent's job, not a quality judgment.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: update_items
